approval.scope: Exact eight entries for owner-only beta; displayed labels are temporary discovery filters; Painting suggested 30 minutes and other durations null; Wine tasting adult activity; no wider age/access/wellness policy approval.

intendedAfterImage.title: Coffee together
intendedAfterImage.description: Make time for a drink and a catch-up with people you know.
tips: Choose a place where everyone can sit together.
Agree a time that works for the group.

intendedAfterImage.title: Painting
intendedAfterImage.description: Paint a scene, an object or an abstract design together. Try different colours and let everyone take their own approach.
tips: Bring paints, brushes and something to paint on.
Look at painting styles for inspiration.

intendedAfterImage.title: Get out with bikes
intendedAfterImage.description: Get together for a bicycle ride and enjoy some time outside.
tips: Agree the route and meeting place in advance.
Choose a route everyone in the group is comfortable with.

intendedAfterImage.title: Building a snowman
intendedAfterImage.description: When there is enough snow, get together to build and decorate a snowman.
tips: Choose a suitable outdoor spot.
Bring warm clothes and simple decorations.

intendedAfterImage.title: BBQ
intendedAfterImage.description: Share a barbecue and spend time together over food.
tips: Agree who is bringing the food and equipment.
Check dietary preferences with your guests.

intendedAfterImage.title: Wine tasting
intendedAfterImage.description: Get together to compare wines and talk about what you notice.
tips: Choose a suitable place and agree what to bring.
Have water and alcohol-free options available.

intendedAfterImage.title: Spa day
intendedAfterImage.description: Set aside time to relax together at a spa.
tips: Choose the place together.
Check availability before confirming your plan.

intendedAfterImage.title: Book Club
intendedAfterImage.description: Meet to talk about a book you have chosen together.
tips: Agree the book before the meeting.
Bring a question or a favourite passage to discuss.
